# Argus

> Pre-Flight Dependency Provenance & AI Slopsquatting Interceptor.

## Core Capabilities
- Slopsquatting Defense: Detects and blocks AI-hallucinated and typosquatted dependencies before package manager invocation.
- Zero-SaaS Local Heuristics: Evaluates release age (<72 hours), Levenshtein distance against canonical registries, author reputation, and version velocity locally.
- Cisco Project Quarry Engine: Standardized telemetry and composite threat scoring engine.
- Killswitch Event Bus: Emits instant SIGKILL notifications across `~/.argus/argus.sock` upon intercepting high-risk packages.

## CLI Usage
- `argus audit --ecosystem <npm|pypi|cargo> --package <name>`: Audits proposed package.
- `argus audit --manifest package.json`: Scans an entire manifest file.
- `argus-shim <pkg_manager> <args>`: Transparent command interceptor wrapper.
- `argus daemon --listen ~/.argus/argus.sock`: Starts the IPC killswitch bus.

## Sockets & Paths
- Event Bus Socket: `~/.argus/argus.sock`
- Config File: `~/.argus/config.yaml`
- Documentation: `docs/knowledge-base/04-argus.md` in repo `spanreed`
